description: Python anchors: host names the Loader, the manager and the shipped mods rely on. Checked against a payload's source files without importing the gateway (floofy_core.anchors); the compat matrix records matched/total per host version (Requirement 9.1).

anchors.why: the Loader's routes are AppRoute(method, path, handler) objects returned from backend.hooks.routes
ctx.hooks route targets swap the live aiohttp route handler found through this registry
how the host imports floofy_loader.hooks by file path (the shim puts the app dir on sys.path)
the App Kit execution gate the agent.apps_trusted grant satisfies
app.json ui.entry, the manager page's vehicle
the unauthenticated /apps/<name>/ui/ route that serves host.mjs, patched chunk copies and boot assets
<host home>/apps, where the Loader app is installed
serves index.html unchanged; the example python-hook and the boot script rely on it
the manager mints its session here with the local secret
the ?token= exchange and cookie the manager session relies on
the served CSP the SPA host and patches were designed against (spike 1.4)
run/gateway-<port>.secret then .local_secret: the manager reads the same files
the channel rule floofy.host mirrors for un-stamped builds
the early shim arms a post-import hook on this module
